[12/13 Regression] ICE (invalid code) in tree check: expected class 'type', have 'exceptional' (error_mark) in create_tmp_from_val, at gimplify.cc sincer12-7222-g3f10e0d50b5e3b3f
This code leads to ICE in GCC-12 and 13:
===
struct a {
  int b
} c() {
  struct a a;
  a.b;
  d a;
===

We are doing a study about compiler fuzzers. We got this from one of the tools. I wonder if such a bug is interesting even if the program is chopped in the middle?
